title: Deprecation Announcement: Odigos Helm Charts Repository
summary: Announcing the deprecation of the Odigos Helm Charts repository. Learn how to switch to the new Helm repository. Follow our easy migration steps to ensure your observability setup stays updated with the latest features and support.
